Package io.constructor.client

Class SearchabilitiesV2Request

java.lang.Object
io.constructor.client.SearchabilitiesV2Request
public class SearchabilitiesV2Request extends Object
Constructor.io Searchabilities V2 Request.

This request class is used for bulk v2 searchability configuration operations (PATCH /v2/searchabilities).

For GET operations, use SearchabilitiesV2GetRequest. For DELETE operations, use SearchabilitiesV2DeleteRequest.
